reviews.title: Lousy App & camera system. AVOID.
reviews.text:
The Swann Security app and wireless cameras have been an enormous disappointment. I expected a reliable home security system, but instead, I got a frustrating combination of poorly designed software and cameras that fail to deliver the dependable performance a security system should provide.

Both the wireless doorbell camera and wireless security camera are only as useful as the app that controls them, and Swann’s app seriously undermines the entire experience. Basic functions should be intuitive, responsive, and reliable. Instead, the system makes monitoring your own property unnecessarily frustrating.

Home security is not an area where unreliable performance and poorly executed technology are acceptable. Customers purchase these products expecting peace of mind, not additional problems and constant frustration.

Swann needs to address the fundamental shortcomings of its app and wireless camera system. I would not recommend these products to anyone looking for dependable home security. Save your money and choose another brand.

reviews.title: Has potential
reviews.text:
This app has the potential to be a very useful security app. The Swann cameras I have installed are very good but unfortunately when it comes to viewing them on this app it’s not as useful. Live view just barely works unless I’m connected to the same network that the cameras are, but you want to be able to view them when you are out. You get similar issues with the playback, I think it’s because it is trying to show you the full quality stream but unless your network has great upload speeds (mine is okay, playback should be fine) playback just pauses to buffer. But even the low quality playback modes load terribly.

Also, trying to find previous events is not easy on this app. I wish it could be like Ring where you have a timeline. This app just breaks clips up into random lengths (my cameras record constantly) and makes it so hard to find events.

UPDATE:
Even now in May 2026, after numerous updates to the app the functionality is still just as bad. It’s impossible to view my cameras away from home, the live view just buffers and falls so far behind real time. It appears that the video feed has no form of compression so tries to send you the full quality stream and will not drop any frames so just falls behind. It’s not a network issue because I can view my cameras just fine on the desktop application without the stuttering. 

It’s really a shame because the cameras and NVR are really good but unless I’m at home or carry my laptop with me, it’s impossible to view them on my
